releaseNotes: OWNER QA v12: Adds supervised AARide Home -> Job Pool -> Upcoming -> Back navigation diagnostics. Offline or unverified Upcoming does not clear My Schedule; full online booking scan remains unverified. Instant Reject All retains narrow v11 real-button proof; issued click is not server confirmation. Instant Filter is diagnostic ONLY: no automatic Accept/Reject until online offer fields are verified. Six condition verdicts, action-block reasons, UI structure and Sync stages are retained in Settings TXT export even with USB Debugging off. Signed with the same permanent certificate as v11. Stop before updating in place; do not uninstall or clear data. Disable USB Debugging/Developer Options to drive AARide Online, run observed test, then share retained TXT log.
